summary: Validated the verification-tag implementation and public pages. The source template and local production build are correct, but both the public and preview hosts serve HTML without the required meta tag.

integration_issues.issue: https://escolinha-admin.emergent.host/ returns HTTP 200 and the login UI, but head meta[name=google-site-verification] count is 0. The preview host also returns 0.

action_items: Publish/redeploy the current frontend build to the public and preview hosts, then verify the served root HTML contains the tag.
critical_code_review_comments: The source uses CRA token substitution correctly and the local build produces exactly one populated verification tag; the failure is not in the checked-in HTML/build artifact but in the deployed artifact or routing/CDN publication.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Local frontend yarn build passed and build/index.html has exactly one populated verification tag. Public and preview root pages both omit it. Public login screen loads with title DDF SPORTS | Painel Administrativo and no visible UI errors. No auth credentials were used; test_credentials.md is an empty template.
rca of the issue: Reproduction: GET https://escolinha-admin.emergent.host/ and inspect head meta[name=google-site-verification]; result count is 0. Source /app/frontend/public/index.html has the tag and frontend/.env has a configured token; yarn build generated one tag with the placeholder replaced. Therefore the hosted origin is serving an older/different frontend artifact or publication layer, rather than the current build.
